data_scope: same complete sealedDEV12 same original native state; no additional scene or label exposure
purpose: Supplement main Phase2 A1/A2/A3 comparisons with all six preregistered simple history rules; do not select one favorable traditional rule or attribute rule-explained repairs to prediction.
interpretation: R_latest has one extra original missed-positive repair and one extra original-unknown-to-known-wrong query vsC1. This is not an online/predictive success and no hyperparameter is changed based on it.
fairness_note: Fixed rules replace C1 history aggregate with the same alpha2; their residual relative to C1 can exceed the new learned innovation clamp. This supplementary strong-rule comparison is separate from the matched bounded learned-head comparison.
